title: Generosity & Legacy
intro: Sharing is the great battle of these years, and it is really a question about whether there is enough. This month answers that question rather than repeating the instruction, and it says what a small child can actually understand about legacy: that kindness travels.

keyScriptures.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

weeks.title: There Is Enough
weeks.declaration: There is enough here. You do not have to hold on tightly, because nothing is going to run out on you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, take the fear of not-enough out of our child's hands. Amen.

weeks.title: Giving Feels Good
weeks.declaration: Giving something away feels better than keeping it. That is odd, and it is true, and you can test it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, let our child discover the gladness of giving rather than being made to give. Amen.

weeks.title: Kindness Travels
weeks.declaration: When someone is kind to you, you can pass it on to someone else. That is how kindness gets everywhere.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, let kindness travel out of this house through our child. Amen.

weeks.title: You Have Something to Give
weeks.declaration: You already have things to give: a turn, a toy, a place next to you, a kind word.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, show our child what they already have to give away. Amen.

days.title: There Is Enough
days.declaration: There is enough here. You do not have to hold on tightly.

scripture.text: My God will meet all your needs.

days.title: Giving Feels Good
days.declaration: Giving something away feels better than keeping it. Try it and see.

scripture.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

days.title: Kindness Travels
days.declaration: When someone is kind to you, pass it on. That is how kindness gets everywhere.

scripture.text: Freely you have received; freely give.

days.title: You Have Something to Give
days.declaration: You have things to give already: a turn, a toy, a place beside you.

scripture.text: Use whatever gift you have received to serve others.

days.title: Sharing Is Not Losing
days.declaration: Sharing does not mean you end up with less of what matters.

scripture.text: One person gives freely, yet gains even more.

days.title: Giving to Someone Small
days.declaration: Be generous to whoever is smaller than you. That is a good habit to start now.

scripture.text: Whatever you did for one of the least of these.

days.title: Notice Who Has None
days.declaration: Look for whoever has not got any. Then give them some.

scripture.text: Whoever is kind to the poor lends to the Lord.

days.title: Giving Quietly
days.declaration: You do not have to tell everybody you shared. Doing it is enough.

scripture.text: Do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.

days.title: Give a Good One
days.declaration: Give the good one, not the broken one. That is what makes it a present.

scripture.text: I will not sacrifice... offerings that cost me nothing.

days.title: Sharing Your Time
days.declaration: Playing with someone who is on their own is a real present. It costs nothing.

scripture.text: Carry each other's burdens.

days.title: Kind Words Are Free
days.declaration: Saying something kind costs nothing and people remember it for ages.

scripture.text: Only what is helpful for building others up.

days.title: Happy to Give
days.declaration: Give because you want to, not because someone made you. God likes that best.

scripture.text: God loves a cheerful giver.

days.title: Being Glad for Others
days.declaration: When someone else gets something nice, you can be glad. That makes you bigger.

scripture.text: Rejoice with those who rejoice.

days.title: Room for One More
days.declaration: There is always room for one more person. Move up.

scripture.text: Practise hospitality.

days.title: Lending Kindly
days.declaration: When you lend something, lend it nicely. Things matter less than people.

scripture.text: Lend to them without expecting to get anything back.

days.title: Giving When You Are Tired
days.declaration: It is easy to be kind when you feel good. It counts more when you do not.

scripture.text: Let us not become weary in doing good.

days.title: Not Counting
days.declaration: Generous people do not keep count of who owes them. Put it down.

scripture.text: Love keeps no record of wrongs.

days.title: Helping at Home
days.declaration: Helping at home counts. It is the hardest place and the most important one.

scripture.text: Anyone who does not provide for their relatives...

days.title: Teaching Someone
days.declaration: If you know how to do something, show someone else. That is generous too.

scripture.text: Entrust to reliable people.

days.title: Giving Away a Turn
days.declaration: Letting someone go first is one of the biggest things you can do at your age.

scripture.text: Value others above yourselves.

days.title: Looking After Things
days.declaration: Looking after your things means someone else can use them later.

scripture.text: If you have not been trustworthy...

days.title: Forgiving Is Giving
days.declaration: Forgiving someone is a kind of present. It is one of the best ones.

scripture.text: Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

days.title: What People Remember
days.declaration: People will remember how you made them feel. That is what you leave behind.

scripture.text: A good name is more desirable than great riches.

days.title: Planting Something
days.declaration: Kindness is like a seed. You do not see it grow the same day.

scripture.text: A man reaps what he sows.

days.title: Someone Gave to You
days.declaration: Somebody gave you things before you could say thank you. You are in a long line.

scripture.text: Cities you did not build.

days.title: Giving to People Who Cannot Give Back
days.declaration: Give to someone who cannot give you anything back. That is the best kind.

scripture.text: Invite the poor... and you will be blessed.

days.title: Our Family Gives
days.declaration: This family gives things away. You will grow up thinking that is normal.

scripture.text: You will abound in every good work.

days.title: Not Only Toys
days.declaration: You can give help, time, a hug or a turn. Not everything you give is a thing.

scripture.text: Serve one another humbly in love.

days.title: Open Hands
days.declaration: An open hand can give and take. A tight fist cannot do either.

scripture.text: Whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

days.title: Starting Now
days.declaration: What you will be like when you are big is starting now, today.

scripture.text: Cast your bread upon the waters.

days.title: Keep Giving It Away
days.declaration: Keep giving things away. It is one of the happiest habits there is.

scripture.text: Give, and it will be given to you.
